<?php
function peerShift221() {
    global $runner, $late, $owner;
    $runner = null; $late = 99; $owner = null;
    echo 'SHIFT;'; return false;
}
class PeerRunnerBase221 {
    public string $text;
    public function __construct($value) { $this->text = $value; echo 'CTOR;'; }
    public function __invoke($saved, $marker) {
        $this->text = $saved;
        echo 'INVOKE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return $this;
    }
    public function run($target) {
        global $late;
        return $target->MiSsInG(first: false, later: (
            $this(...)
        )($late, peerShift221()));
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'THIS-END;'; }
}
class PeerRunnerChild221 extends PeerRunnerBase221 {}
class PeerMagicBase221 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $kept; $kept = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
class PeerMagicChild221 extends PeerMagicBase221 {}
$owner = new PeerMagicChild221;
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$runner = new PeerRunnerChild221($late);
$result = $runner->run($owner);
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept->text, ';';
unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
